usedFor: Autopilot tracks your clients and jobs; Zoom hosts the webinar you invite them to. A “New Client” in Autopilot can run “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom, signing the client up.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Autopilot, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: New clients can be limited to clients or leads only, so onboarding webinars reach the right group without anyone entering names.

watchOut: “Register Attendee for Webinar” needs a specific webinar chosen, and “Updated Client” fires on any change, so one person could be registered twice. Stay on “New Client”.
